subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The biology teacher said, 'When people know the name of something, they often notice it more.'”?
options: The teacher asked Jenny to sing along.
The music teacher said this happens often.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The biology teacher said, 'When people know the name of something, they often notice it more.' The teacher was right.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Their teacher watched and smiled.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The teacher asked Jenny to sing along.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The music teacher said this happens often.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The biology teacher said, 'When people know the name of something, they often notice it more.' The teacher was right.」，答案為「The teacher was right.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The teacher was right.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
